title: Hydro Flask Insulated Mug for Coffee, Tea, Hot Chocolate - Leak-Resistant Lid, Keeps Drinks Hot
description:
About this item
INSULATED MUG: The Hydro Flask stainless steel insulated mug keeps drinks hot for hours. Sized for the perfect cup with a closeable, leak-resistant and splash-resistant lid
HOT STAYS HOT: Thanks to the double-wall vacuum insulation, drinks stay hot or cold for hours in this mug. The TempShield insulation ensures the perfect temp, so your drink is always ready for the next sip

This is a review of Hydro Flask Stainless Steel Reusable Mug - Vacuum Insulated, BPA-Free, Non-Toxic

I really love this 12 ounce Hydro flask insulated mug. The coating of the outside of the mug is kind of soft feeling and when you put it on a hard surface it doesn't clink like something that would just be plain metal.

I also like the way that the spout opens and closes on the top. Although the spout cover is not leak proof, that doesn't bother me because this is a coffee mug, and I don't normally place a coffee mug on its side.

I also like the rounded handle which is very comfortable to put my fingers through and whether you put two or three fingers through it then you can use your little finger or second finger to sort of go underneath it and support the mug.

My only minor issue is that they recommend that you hand wash this and I think that's probably to protect the finish on the mug. I really like the look of the mug and I don't want to risk it so I will hand wash this, and that's not that big of a deal.

My Ninja coffee make brews coffee at 177°. I've measured the temperature using a digital thermometer and an hour later the mug still keeps my coffee about 150 to 155°. An hour after that it's still warm enough to be comfortable drinking but not what I would call tepid. So this basically keeps my coffee hot for two hours which is awesome. I like the different colors that this is available in. I think it's a solid purchase.This mug is amazing. One time i left it overnight filled with ice water, and there was still ice in it in the morning. It works great with hot drinks too. I believe it's even better than a heated mug for coffee. I have bought 3 and very happy with the purchase.My “go to” mug. Coffee stays hot forever! Buyer should know that the lid is not spill proof - if tilted, it can leak.
Stainless steel cleans easily.
